name: Faisal Amin
headline: Senior Cloud and ERP Technical Consultant
about:
As an experienced Cloud and ERP Technical Consultant, I specialize in delivering mission-critical ERP system implementations, development, administration, and support. My expertise spans traditional and cloud-based ERP solutions, technical consulting, and large-scale system integration. With extensive experience in wide range of technologies, I bring technical depth and business alignment to every project.

Key Expertise:
---------------
Operating Systems: Linux/Unix major flavours and Windows servers.
ERP Systems: MFG/PRO, QAD On-Premise
Cloud ERP & SaaS: Implementing and optimizing cloud QAD EE / AE ERP systems for scalability and efficiency on .Net UI, WebUI.
Development: Python, Progress OpenEdge 4GL, Linux Shell Scripting, Agile Methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), GIT, GITHub, QAD CVC.
Database: Progress OpenEdge, MySQL, Oracle on Linux/Unix/Windows.
Functional Domains: Working knowledge of Finance and Distribution
System Integrations: Wide range of technologies like Boomi, Snaplogic, QXtend, Shell Scripting
Containerization: Docker, Docker Swarm, Oracle VBox
Training & Leadership: Delivering online and classroom-based training, project management, and team leadership.
IT Controls, and Security Strategy along with developing and implementing disaster recovery and business continuity strategies.
---------------

With a customer-focused approach and a passion for leveraging technology to solve complex business challenges, I am committed to delivering impactful solutions that drive operational excellence.
